sloka: अथ गद्गदशब्दस्तु विलपन्मनुजाधिपः ।उवाच मृदुमन्धार्थम् वचनम् दीन मस्वरम् ॥२-४२-२५॥
transliteration: atha gadgadaśabdastu vilapanmanujādhipaḥ ।uvāca mṛdumandhārtham vacanam dīna masvaram ॥2-42-25॥

translations.english: The palace without Rama, Lakshmana and Sita, stood like a vast, unperturbed lake with serpents snatched away by Suparna (Garuda).
